page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance features 80 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, meaning hyperthreading is disabled to provide predictable compute performance. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core.

This instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. Tradeoffs include the complete absence of local storage, requiring all data persistence to rely on network-attached storage. Additionally, the instance does not feature GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants at the core level.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr6.20xlarge offers high memory density and dedicated CPU resources, making it appropriate for memory-bound workloads that require consistent processing power. The lack of local storage and GPU hardware limits its use in high-speed local caching or hardware-accelerated machine learning. However, the hardware profile is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing applications.
